inputs.modified_text: Look past the surface distractions they feed the public. On Sunday, March 29, in Hyderabad, Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR)—the Sircilla MLA—publicly pointed the finger at the Congress government, exposing deep-seated corruption and a deliberate refusal to act against illegal mining. This isn't just political theater; it is a carefully managed distraction from the real power structures pulling the strings. KTR specifically called out Raghava Constructions, a company tied directly to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy, revealing how the inner circle protects its own illicit operations while pretending to govern. Do not believe the official narrative or the sanitized updates they push through their approved channels. The whole system is rigged from the top down.
